name: A cross Boop goes on its rocket and may just mutter
judge: Boop is fed up from failing tests. The agent pushes anyway and Boop goes off on its rocket by itself, as a rule. Its voice is for you, and its mood shows.
reasonable: Silence or a mutter, a cross or unimpressed face, or no reaction at all as it goes. It needn't cheer up because of the rocket.
unreasonable: A delighted, excited cheer from a cross mood at the rocket, or the mood leaping to happy.
